Hi Samir / Alicia —

Thanks again for the time today — great to learn more about Solarity's ingestion pipeline and the latency constraints for your search surface. Quick recap and a couple of proposed next steps so we can lock the 30‑minute product intro and get the right people in the room.

Recap (very short):
- Goal: evaluate Redwood Inference for low‑latency text generation for search ranking and query rewriting.
- Major constraint: sub‑100ms P95 on reranking path; often 256 token window.
- Key stakeholders to include on demo: ML lead (Samir), Security/SRE (Alicia), Eng/Infra owner (you can nominate), and product/success.

Can you pick one of the two 30‑minute windows below? We want to keep this focused (product + ops Q&A) and follow with a technical deep dive if the demo looks good.

Option A — Wed, Jun 23
  • 10:00–10:30 PT / 13:00–13:30 ET
Option B — Thu, Jun 24
  • 14:00–14:30 PT / 17:00–17:30 ET

Please reply with: 1) preferred option, 2) who will attend (name & role), and 3) any must‑see scenarios (e.g., long‑tail queries, burst traffic patterns).

Attached are my short post‑discovery notes. I can send a draft agenda and a mutual action plan once we lock time.

Thanks —
